description: This Java class 'AdvancedPaymentAllocationsValidator' provides validation logic for advanced payment allocation rules within a loan product context in the Fineract project. It includes methods for validating payment strategies, checking for duplicates, order correctness, and grouping rules.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentAllocationsValidator
classes.description: A service class that validates advanced payment allocation rules for loan products, ensuring correct order, uniqueness, and consistency of payment strategies.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a list of payment allocation rules against a specified payment strategy code, checking for presence of default rules, duplicates, and correctness.

methods.name: validatePairOfOrderAndPaymentAllocationType
methods.description: Validates that a list of pairs (order, payment allocation type) contains exactly 12 entries, with unique types and correct order.

methods.name: checkGroupingOfAllocationRules
methods.description: Checks the grouping of allocation types within each payment allocation rule for consistency.

methods.name: validateAllocationType
methods.description: Validates individual payment allocation types for correct due type and consistency.

methods.name: validateDueType
methods.description: Ensures due types are not mixed in unsupported ways.

methods.name: hasDuplicateTransactionTypes
methods.description: Checks for duplicate transaction types in a list of rules.

methods.name: validateAllocationRule
methods.description: Validates individual loan product payment allocation rules for valid transaction type and future installment rule.

methods.name: isAdvancedPaymentStrategy
methods.description: Checks if the given code matches the advanced payment allocation strategy.

methods.name: hasAtLeastOneDefaultPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Verifies if at least one default transaction type is present in the rules.

methods.name: hasLoanProductPaymentAllocationRule
methods.description: Checks if the list of rules is non-empty.

methods.name: raiseValidationError
methods.description: Throws a validation exception with a specified error message.
